## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.7 — mobile polish and a stretched-canvas fix

> **Alpha.** The Android APK has still never run on a phone. Desktop paths are
> verified on Linux only. For something that has been used in anger, stay on
> [v0.0.1](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.1).

### A real bug, on desktop too

The colour picker sized its drawing surface by subtracting a hardcoded 180px
for the header and footer. Those are actually **152.6px**, so the canvas was
27px shorter than the box it was drawn into and the gradient had been quietly
stretched — on every platform, since this release. It now measures itself, so
the two match exactly and cannot drift when the CSS changes.

### Mobile

- Touch targets under the 44px minimum now grow on touch devices: the header
  icon buttons (36px) and the scene favourite star (32px). The star matters
  more than its size suggests — a mis-tap silently undoes a favourite.
- The room filter becomes a **bottom sheet** on a phone instead of a 170px
  dropdown pinned to the toolbar.
- The per-card background blur is halved on touch devices. It is composited
  once per light card, so a phone showing a dozen of them paid for it a dozen
  times.
- Safe-area insets for notches and gesture bars.

Desktop layout is deliberately untouched — these are behind
`@media (pointer: coarse)`.

### Android signing

Releases can now produce a signed APK when a keystore secret is configured;
without one they keep producing the debug-signed build, so forks still build.
See the Android section of
[PACKAGING.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/PACKAGING.md) —
including the part about never losing the keystore, since Android identifies
an app by its signature.

### What is not here

Screen sync from Android (`MediaProjection`) remains unimplemented. It is the
last item in
[plans/03-execution-phases.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/plans/03-execution-phases.md),
and it is the one piece that cannot be written responsibly without a device to
test on.
